purpose: Separate history, segment and representation costs without repeating the published study
text: Each fixed-v1 4096-byte segment starts with amber followed by a unique decimal index and ASCII spaces; no equal segment bytes
history_policy: alternating original and exact-v1; warm supported EvaluateAndTraceLexical API creates history outside measurements
diagnostic: one stage-instrumented query per fixture/history/policy; CPU profile diverse200 exact; allocations separate later
smoke: small and diverse with two histories; validate schemas, counts, canonical outputs, input hashes and worker receipt before diagnostic
stopping: Stop on nonzero exit, timeout, wrong counts, output mismatch, resource limit; retain failed attempt. No timed retries for favorable results.
concurrency: After selecting a candidate, deterministic reader snapshot plus independent writer progress, WAL checkpoint blocking/release and later-operation damage visibility; bounded 30 seconds
candidate_gate: Select only after profile; no opening pass removal, historical-check removal, cross-operation cache or policy change
